_comment: Markers proving each patch class is actually compiled into the built artifact.
The build gate (scripts/verify_patch_markers.py, run from Dockerfile.prod) fails
the build if any marker is absent — a missing marker means the artifact was
compiled from stale/unpatched source. This is the check that would have caught
the 2026-05 stale-build incident: the synthesizeMouseEvent juggler fix was absent
from the shipped omni.ja even though version.json claimed the patched build.
libxul_markers: C++ symbols/strings that must appear in libxul.so.
omni_markers:   identifiers that must appear in juggler JS inside omni.ja.
When you add a patch that introduces a NEW capability, add a stable marker for
it here so the gate proves it shipped. Prefer code identifiers (function names)
over comments — comments can be stripped, identifiers can't.
